metadata.title: संघ की डीलिस्टिंग रैली के जवाब में बंधु तिर्की की एकता रैली | Ekta rally to counter Delisting rally
metadata.description: Bandhu Tirkey, the Congress Working President in Jharkhand, has announced his intention to lead the Adivasi Ekta Maharally in Ranchi on February 4th. This rally serves as a response to the demonstrations organized by the Janjati Suraksha Manch, which advocates for the delisting of tribals who have converted to other religions. Despite reports of dissatisfaction within his party regarding the unilateral decision to hold the rally without prior consultation, Bandhu Tirkey remains resolute in his commitment. In an interview with Main Bhi Bharat, he affirmed his determination to proceed with the rally, emphasizing that it will take place regardless of any internal party discord. This event underscores the complex dynamics and differing perspectives within the party regarding the issue of tribal conversions.
